reason: The paragraph says the factors which come together in the coniunctio ARE opposites; the coniunctio unites opposites (or is itself the union of opposites). 'Coniunctio unites union-of-opposites' is malformed — it makes the coniunctio unite its own definition.

correction.subject: coniunctio
correction.note: Alternatively: coniunctio —unites→ opposites. The object of 'unites' must be the opposites themselves, not the union of them.

reason: Paragraph states verbatim that 'the alchemical Sol corresponds psychologically to consciousness, the diurnal side of the psyche' — Jung's own recap of his psychological equation. Direction and claim_type correct.

Jung asserts in his own voice that the primary pair of opposites is 'consciousness and unconsciousness, whose symbols are Sol and Luna' — Luna is the symbol/analogue of the unconscious. Direction correct.

The paragraph (Dorn's three stages: unio mentalis, union with body, union with unus mundus) never mentions individuation; the quote about 'merely the first stage' concerns the unio mentalis within the coniunctio procedure, not a prefiguration of individuation. Edge unsupported by this paragraph.

Sol and Luna are named as the symbols of 'the primary pair of opposites, consciousness and unconsciousness' — the paragraph directly casts them as an opposed pair. Symmetric relation, so no direction issue.

In the chapter on the factors united in the coniunctio, Jung states 'the masculine-feminine opposition is personified as King and Queen' — the King is a standard personification of the masculine partner of the coniunctio; apt amplification-layer image.
Same paragraph: the Queen personifies the feminine pole of the masculine-feminine opposition whose union is the coniunctio. Valid amplification image.

The paragraph identifies the speaker as 'the feminine personification of the prima materia in the nigredo state' and names her the black Shulamite (contaminated with Eve) — the Shulamite amplifies the nigredo. jung-reports-parallel fits Jung's reporting of the Song of Songs/Cabala parallel.

The Tifereth-Malchuth reunion ('the coming Messiah will reunite the King with the Queen') is indeed presented as a hierosgamos parallel to the coniunctio, but the parallel is Jung's construction over Cabalistic material — Knorr is quoted only for the widow/Malchuth definition, and Knorr nowhere asserts the alchemical-coniunctio link. jung-quotes-source overstates the sourcing.

correction.source: Cabala (Knorr von Rosenroth, Kabbala Denudata, cited)

reason: Jung states Adam Kadmon 'as a personification of the whole inverted tree, is androgynous' and calls the Sefiroth system 'a highly differentiated coniunctio symbol', in a passage on Cabalistic statements that 'found their way into alchemy' — a genuine reported parallel to the alchemical hermaphrodite/Rebis.

Jung reports Dorn's view that 'the third and highest degree of conjunction was the union of the whole man with the unus mundus' — the coniunctio culminates in the unus mundus, correctly typed as jung-quotes-source with Dorn named.

The paragraph opens 'Mercurius, however, is not just the medium of conjunction but also that which is to be united' — Mercurius as medium of the coniunctio is directly asserted (the edge captures the mediating role; his additionally being the united substance does not contradict it).

The generative relation is supported ('Sol therefore derives from sulphur'), but it rests on a reported alchemical designation — 'it was called the prima materia of Sol' — so casting it as jung-asserts overstates it; this is Jung relaying alchemical doctrine.

correction.subject: sulphur
correction.source: alchemical tradition (sulphur 'called the prima materia of Sol')

reason: Jung asserts in his own expository voice: 'In philosophical alchemy, salt is a cosmic principle. According to its position in the quaternity, it is correlated with the feminine, lunar side.' Relation and direction exact.

The paragraph frames salt within 'the phenomenology of the self': salt appears as the cubic crystal that 'represents the centre and hence the self', its quaternary sign parallels mandalas, and its lapis-synonyms are treated as 'symbols of the self'. The symbolizes-edge is Jung's own psychological reading here.
'The theriomorphic form of Sol as a lion and dog' — the lion is directly given as a theriomorphic image of Sol.
Same sentence gives the theriomorphic form 'of Luna as a bitch' — direct amplification image.

In an explicitly psychological passage (Sol = consciousness), Jung says of Sol 'that he either possesses a shadow or is even a Sol niger' — Sol niger as image of the shadow side of consciousness is supported.
'Sol being naturally understood as the gold' — the Sol-gold identification is stated as the standard alchemical understanding; valid amplification image.
The paragraph states 'Luna also signifies silver' and that 'silver is yet another synonym or symbol for the arcanum Luna' — the Luna-silver amplification holds in both formulations.
Jung states as his own summary: 'Altogether, sulphur is one of the innumerable synonyms for the prima materia in its dual aspect' — synonym relation directly asserted.

'For Paracelsus sulphur, together with Sal (salt), is the begetter of Mercurius' — the begetting claim is Paracelsus's, correctly typed jung-quotes-source with Paracelsus named. Direction correct (sulphur begets Mercurius, who is 'born of the sun and moon').
Same Paracelsus report: Sal is co-begetter of Mercurius with sulphur. Claim_type and source correct.

'In alchemy the lion, the royal beast, is a synonym for Mercurius, or, to be more accurate, for a stage in his transformation' — lion as image of Mercurius directly asserted; the stage-qualification does not overturn the amplification.
'In the lion hunt of Marchos the lion, as we have seen, takes the place of the king' — the lion substitutes for Rex; direct amplification support.
